headline: Bulgaria's Borissov: “Even Children Know That the Drones Are Russian”
summary: GERB leader Boyko Borissov said authorities should identify drones attacking ships in Bulgaria's exclusive economic zone and act against them. He responded to Defense Minister Dimitar Stoyanov's remarks on the drones' origin.
why: Security threats to shipping lanes and exclusive economic zones affect maritime traffic, insurance costs and defence spending decisions in the Black Sea region.
